note: sha256 of each document shared with the Hub (Robot Overflow), pinned so a divergence is caught with one checkout — which is what CI has. Written by tools/check-mirrors.mjs --sync (take their copies, then pin) or --pin (move nothing, pin what already agrees). A document the two trees differ on keeps its last agreed digest rather than being re-pinned or dropped. Never edit by hand: a digest somebody updated to match a local edit is a check that has been switched off.
